pr_title: [action] plugin_scores: Add support for rendering multiline description of plugin actions on docs
pr_body:
### Checklist - [x] I've run `bundle exec rspec` from the root directory to see all new and existing tests pass - [x] I've followed the _fastlane_ code style and run `bundle exec rubocop -a` to ensure the code style is valid - [x] I've read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) - [x] I've updated the documentation if necessary. ### Motivation and Context > On docs.fastlane.tools, action description is only the last line when multi-line Ruby string is used: > > https://github.com/fastlane/docs/blob/93169702a4f3c090824c08747f3b7050f3094ee1/plugin_scores_cache.yml#L4560 > > vs > >https://github.com/dotdoom/fastlane-plugin-flutter/blob/23d517049d11da95563d35f76bfd44a64eb54eeb/lib/fastlane/plugin/flutter/actions/flutter_generate_action.rb#L36-L39 closes https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/15201 ### Description When a method called `description` is detected, we basically concat description lines till the end of the block. I generated the docs locally and multiline descriptions look good 👍 **Important note** ⚠️ The following description won't be rendered correctly on the docs site due to breaking markdown `${...}` https://github.com/dotdoom/fastlane-plugin-flutter/blob/23d517049d11da95563d35f76bfd44a64eb54eeb/lib/fastlane/plugin/flutter/actions/flutter_generate_action.rb#L35-L40 I modified the description locally: ```
Provided actions Name | Category | Description ------|----------|------------ **flutter_bootstrap** | - | Flutter SDK installation, upgrade and application bootstrap **flutter** | - | Run "flutter" binary with the specified arguments **flutter_build** | building | Run "flutter build" to build a Flutter application **flutter_generate** | - | According to package:intl, take `$strings_file` and generate `${strings_file.dirname}/arb/intl_messages.arb`, then take all files matching `${strings_file.dirname}/intl_*.arb`, fix them and generate .dart files from them
``` and got: ### Testing steps To test these changes, please point a `fastlane` version in your `Gemfile` to my branch and follow the instructions from [docs repository](https://github.com/fastlane/docs) 🙇

issue_context.title: plugin_scores: Fastlane docs parse only the last line of multiline action Description
issue_context.body:
<!-- Thanks for helping fastlane! Before you submit your issue, please make sure you followed our checklist and check the appropriate boxes by putting an x in the [ ]: [x] -->

### New Issue Checklist

- [x] Updated fastlane to the latest version
- [x] I read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I read [docs.fastlane.tools](https://docs.fastlane.tools)
- [x] I searched for [existing GitHub issues](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues)

### Issue Description

On docs.fastlane.tools, action description is only the last line when multi-line Ruby string is used:

https://github.com/fastlane/docs/blob/93169702a4f3c090824c08747f3b7050f3094ee1/plugin_scores_cache.yml#L4560

vs

https://github.com/dotdoom/fastlane-plugin-flutter/blob/23d517049d11da95563d35f76bfd44a64eb54eeb/lib/fastlane/plugin/flutter/actions/flutter_generate_action.rb#L36-L39
comments:
It seems like you have not included the output of `fastlane env`

To make it easier for us help you resolve this issue, please update the issue to include the output of `fastlane env` :+1:

Uh, thanks for noticing and reporting this. The way `plugin_scores_cache.yml` gets filled seems to be broken then and should definitely be fixed. (The plugin directory in general could use a _lot_ of love).

Turns out although this is a docs problem, the code for this actually _does_ like in `fastlane/fastlane` as a special action: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/fastlane/actions/plugin_scores.rb
The problem is probably inside this somewhere: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/fastlane/helper/plugin_scores_helper.rb

The action is parsed into a file:

```ruby
              actions = Dir["**/actions/*.rb"].map do |action_file|
                FastlaneActionFileParser.new.parse_file(action_file)
              end
```

The `FastlaneActionFileParser` iterates each line. It basically looks for a string, and places it in `last_string_statement` until `is_end?` returns `true`.

The parser even implicitly acknowledges multi-line strings won't work with the comment:

```ruby
# All the ways ruby can represent single-line strings
```

So we either need to:

- Add multiline string support to `FastlaneActionFileParser`, or
- Disallow multiline strings in fastlane actions (maybe some kind of spec in https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/tree/master/fastlane/spec/plugins_specs?)
Also as far as I can tell, `FastlaneActionFileParser` isn't under test :(

Hey guys 👋 

@getaaron thank you so much for your help! ❤️ 

I've spent some time on investigation of this issue and would like to share my findings:

1. PR with the fix is ready for review 

I created the PR with the fix, although @dotdoom you will need to update the description of your plugin. More details in the PR's description. 

2. Workaround

As a quick workaround, you could write a description in a single line. A long, single line description renders pretty well on [`Available Plugins`](https://docs.fastlane.tools/plugins/available-plugins/) site, i.e. `airwatch_workspaceone`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10795657/63411820-a2ab0980-c3f6-11e9-94ca-c8f50bced17f.png)

🙇

Thank you, I made this [change](https://github.com/dotdoom/fastlane-plugin-flutter/commit/63ede188f18ea6f7a795dbf8dda71c21297273b7) when I discovered about this issue, but looks like it hasn't been picked up yet:

https://docs.fastlane.tools/plugins/available-plugins/#flutter

Thanks @mollyIV for sending a PR so quickly and @janpio for CCing me on it.
I think update of this is only done on release of fastlane.

The pull request #15212 that closed this issue was merged and released as part of [_fastlane_ 2.130.0](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/releases/tag/2.130.0) :rocket:
Please let us know if the functionality works as expected as a reply here. If it does not, please open a new issue. Thanks!

review_comments: Won't `last_string_statement` always be `nil` here? 🤔 It gets `nil`-ed on line 309 and 344.

Good question 👍 

> It gets nil-ed on line 309 

This one 👆 is before parsing the lines. 

> ... and 344.

It gets `nil`-ed on the end of the line. The regex to detect the end of the line looks like this:

```
def is_end?(line)
    !!line.match(/^\s*end\s*/)
end
```

So if we have a multi-line description, the end of the line is not detected and `last_string_statement` is not nil then 😉
